variants.hook: Manual reconciliation eats hours every week.
variants.body:
Manual reconciliation eats hours every week.

You know the routine. The weekly report comes out, and before anyone acts on it someone has to hand-check the inventory figures against the order records. That hand-check is where the week gets lost. In a pilot across 14 warehouses, teams using automated data checks cut the time spent on manual reconciliation by 31%.

The checks run on a schedule. They compare inventory records with order and shipment records and flag mismatches for a person to review. They do not change any records themselves.

That is the data quality work sitting in operations, not in the IT department.
